segments.name: North America
segments.description: Markets, distributes and sells diagnostic instruments and assays for hospitals, laboratories and other testing sites in North America.
segments.evidence: We manage our business geographically to better align with the market dynamics of the specific geographic regions in which we operate, with our reportable segments being North America, EMEA, China, JPAC and Latin America.

segments.name: EMEA
segments.description: Markets, distributes and sells diagnostic instruments and assays for hospitals, laboratories and other testing sites in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
segments.evidence: The CODM reviews the Company's performance and allocates resources based on five operating segments: North America, EMEA, China, JPAC and Latin America, all of which are reportable segments.

segments.name: China
segments.description: Markets, distributes and sells diagnostic instruments and assays for hospitals, laboratories and other testing sites in China.
segments.evidence: We operate under five geographically-based reportable segments: North America, EMEA, China, JPAC and Latin America.

segments.name: JPAC
segments.description: Markets, distributes and sells diagnostic instruments and assays for hospitals and laboratories in the Japan and Asia Pacific region.
segments.evidence: Beginning in the fourth quarter of 2025, we determined that the JPAC segment, previously included in "Other," meets the quantitative thresholds for separate reporting under ASC 280.

segments.name: Latin America
segments.description: Markets, distributes and sells diagnostic instruments and assays for hospitals and laboratories in Latin America.
segments.evidence: Although all five segments are engaged in the marketing, distribution and sale of diagnostic instruments and assays

revenueModel.text: Hospitals, clinical laboratories, physician offices and other testing sites pay QuidelOrtho for diagnostic instruments and assays.
revenueModel.evidence: We currently sell our products directly to end users through a direct sales force and through a network of distributors

changes.text: In the fourth quarter of 2025 JPAC became a separately reported segment, having previously been included in Other.
changes.evidence: Beginning in the fourth quarter of 2025, we determined that the JPAC segment, previously included in "Other," meets the quantitative thresholds for separate reporting under ASC 280.

changes.text: In 2024 QuidelOrtho began winding down its U.S. donor screening portfolio.
changes.evidence: In February 2024, we initiated a wind-down plan to transition out of the U.S. donor screening portfolio.
